versions.changelog:
Initial release for the migrate-to-codex skill:

- Supports full migration of Claude Code instructions, skills, agents, and MCP config into Codex project and global files.
- Guides a self-healing migration workflow, including inspection, conversion, dry-run, artifact validation, and post-migration checks.
- Respects autonomy and does not prompt for confirmation on managed actions.
- Provides a structured markdown migration report highlighting added, changed, or skipped Codex artifacts.
- Preserves unrelated Codex config and avoids editing source Claude files or unrelated project code.
